reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire on Nibbit for 0, consuming the 3 Sparks; Kaboom! on Nibbit for its printed cost of 1; then Imaginary Friend for 1.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Kaboom! first for 0, then Rapid Fire for 2. It dealt the same total damage but left no energy for Imaginary Friend.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It spent all 2 Energy and left Duck and Cover unplayed. It also committed the Spark discount to Rapid Fire rather than Kaboom!.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. On the information given, the same line deals 23 damage, gains 5 Block, and gains the printed Burst benefits while fitting exactly within the available Energy, so a different telegraphed intent would not change it.
